title: AssistantDomain
description: Application-package assistant.domain section (ADR 0047): declares the host domain so the assistant may use knowledge and web search only inside it. Additive on the application manifest.

description.description: Short description of the application's domain (shown to the model).

in_scope.description: Topic areas that are in domain.

out_of_scope.description: Explicit out-of-scope areas (general chatbot use, unrelated hobbies, etc.).

examples.description: Per-language examples of in-domain and out-of-domain questions.

knowledge_allowed.description: Whether general knowledge may be used for in-domain explanations (ability knowledge must still be on).

web_search_allowed.description: Whether the package permits web search in this domain (ability web_search must still be on).

preferred_web_hosts.description: Hosts the package prefers for official sources (intersected with tenant allow lists).
